expect_history_contains: Lotus Vale -- fewer than 2 untapped lands to sacrifice: put into the graveyard (the land drop is used)
comment: Blood Sun step 2: LOTUS VALE WITH ONE UNTAPPED LAND GOES TO THE GRAVEYARD AND SPENDS THE DROP (human path only -- fold V1 keeps the autonomous land choice from ever making this drop). Swamp untapped, Forest tapped: the replacement needs two UNTAPPED lands, so the Vale never enters (oracle ruling: it goes directly to the graveyard). Playing it was the special action (CR 305.1), so the Mountain can no longer be played this turn and Lightning Bolt has no {R}: the opponent stays at 20. Nothing is sacrificed.
